# 世界状态 World State
- 阶段 phase=TITLE
- 任务 mission=(无 null)
- 房间 room=(无 null)
- 玩家 player pos=(0,0) vel=(0,0) facing=0.0° hp=1 weapon=fist(拳头) ammo=0 mode=melee reloading=0s mask=null kills=0 hitsTaken=0
- 存活敌人 aliveEnemies=0
- 活动光源 activeLights=0

# 规则 Rules(常量表 Constants)
## 玩家 Player
- PLAYER_SPEED_MAX=8 u/s 最大移动速度
- PLAYER_ACCEL=60 u/s² 加速度 / PLAYER_DECEL=80 u/s² 减速度
- PLAYER_BOUND_X=[-16,16] PLAYER_BOUND_Y=[-9,9] 世界边界
- PLAYER_RADIUS=0.5 u 碰撞半径
- PLAYER_MELEE_RANGE=1.4 u / PLAYER_MELEE_ARC_DEG=60° / PLAYER_MELEE_DURATION=0.2s 近战
- PLAYER_DASH_SPEED=14 u/s × 0.2s,冷却 1s 冲刺
- PLAYER_DODGE_INVULN=0.4s 无敌,冷却 1.5s 翻滚
- PLAYER_RELOAD_DURATION=1.5s 换弹
- PLAYER_HITS_TO_KILL_BOSS=3 BOSS 击数
- MODE_SWITCH_DURATION=0.15s F 切换近战/远程硬直
- THROW_HOLD_DURATION=0.25s E 长按投掷阈值
## 武器 Weapons(v1 锁 8 件)
- knife 小刀 Knife: type=melee damage=1 ammo=∞ fireRate=5/s reloadTime=0s range=1.40u spread=0
- bat 棒球棍 Bat: type=melee damage=1 ammo=∞ fireRate=1.50/s reloadTime=0s range=2u spread=0
- mauser_c96 毛瑟 C96 Mauser C96: type=ranged damage=1 ammo=10 fireRate=2/s reloadTime=1.50s range=24u spread=0.01
- boxer 盒子炮 Boxer (Broomhandle): type=ranged damage=1 ammo=20 fireRate=10/s reloadTime=2s range=18u spread=0.05
- thompson 汤普森冲锋枪 Thompson: type=ranged damage=1 ammo=50 fireRate=12/s reloadTime=3s range=20u spread=0.04
- mosin 莫辛纳甘 Mosin-Nagant: type=ranged damage=1 ammo=5 fireRate=1/s reloadTime=2.50s range=64u spread=0.005
- grenade 手雷 Grenade: type=throw damage=1 ammo=3 fireRate=1/s reloadTime=0s range=12u spread=0
- throwing_knife 飞刀 Throwing Knife: type=throw damage=1 ammo=5 fireRate=1.50/s reloadTime=0s range=16u spread=0 silent
## 面具 Masks(v1 锁 6 个)
- actor 戏子 Actor: 进入房间 0.5 秒内,所有敌人攻击延迟。 effect=slowMoOnRoomEnter(duration=0.5s, factor=0.3)
- runner 帮工 Runner: 拾取武器时弹药直接满。 effect=ammoRefillOnPickup
- righteous 蒙面义士 Righteous: 一击必杀范围 +0.5u。 effect=meleeRangeBonus(+0.5u)
- dancer 舞女 Dancer: 翻滚冷却减半。 effect=dodgeCooldownMult(x0.5)
- waiter 茶馆跑堂 Waiter: 敌人视野和听觉 -30%。 effect=enemySenseMult(x0.7)
- officer 军爷 Officer: 持远程武器时移动速度 +20%。 effect=playerSpeedMult(x1.2, requiresWeapon=ranged)
## 敌人 Enemies(4 种 archetype)
- soldier 占领军: hp=1 speedPatrol=3 speedAlert=5 fireRate=1.5/s reactionTime=0.4s weapon=mosin rank=normal
- policeman 巡捕: hp=1 speedPatrol=3 speedAlert=5 fireRate=1.5/s reactionTime=0.4s weapon=mauser_c96 rank=normal
- spy 特务: hp=1 speedPatrol=4 speedAlert=6 fireRate=2/s reactionTime=0.3s weapon=boxer rank=elite
- boss 头目: hp=3 speedPatrol=4 speedAlert=6 fireRate=2/s reactionTime=0.3s weapon=thompson rank=boss
- 感知 / 索敌(全局):
  - ENEMY_VIEW_DISTANCE=8 u 视野距离 / ENEMY_VIEW_ARC_DEG=60° 视野锥角
  - ENEMY_HEAR_DISTANCE=4 u 听觉距离 / ENEMY_FIRE_DISTANCE=14 u 开火距离
  - ENEMY_REACT_TIME=0.4s 反应时间 / ENEMY_FIRE_RATE=1.5/s 射速
  - ENEMY_HITS_TO_KILL=1(一击必杀)/ BOSS_HITS=3
## 任务 / 房间 Mission & Room
- TASKS_TOTAL=4 任务数 / HIDDEN_TASK_REQUIRED_S=3 隐藏任务 S 条件
- MISSION_DURATION_TARGET=180s 目标时长
- ROOM_ENTER_FADE=1s 进入淡入 / ROOM_CLEAR_DELAY=0.8s 清场延迟 / ROOM_EXIT_FADE=0.5s 退出淡出
- DEATH_RESPAWN_DELAY=1.2s 死亡重生 / BRIEF_TYPEWRITER_SPEED=0.04s/字 打字机
- 评分阈值: S≥90 A≥75 B≥60 C≥0
## RC 管线 RC Pipeline
- RC_CASCADE_COUNT=3 / RC_BASE_RAY_COUNT=4 / RC_BASE_INTERVAL_PX=0.5px
- RC_JFA_PASSES=-1(-1=自动 log2(min(W,H))) / RC_JFA_RESOLUTION_SCALE=1
- RC_PROPAGATION_RATE=0.85 / RC_MIX_FACTOR=0.5 / RC_MAX_ACTIVE_LIGHTS=16
- RC_RAY_BUDGET_PER_PIXEL=16 / RC_RAY_BUDGET_TOTAL_HARD_CAP=64 / RC_MAX_RAY_STEPS=128
- RC_LIGHT_INTENSITY_GAMMA=2.2 / RC_DITHER_MATRIX_SIZE=4×4 Bayer
## RC 光源 RC Lights(8 类)
- muzzle_flash 枪火: #ffaa3a i=1 r=8u ttl=0.05s
- explosion 爆炸: #ffaa3a i=2 r=6u ttl=0.2s
- oil_lamp 油灯: #ffc966 i=0.4 r=5u ttl=static
- neon_sign 霓虹: #3ad8ff i=0.6 r=12u ttl=static pulse=sine@0.5Hz
- searchlight 探照灯: #e0e0ff i=0.8 r=16u ttl=static pulse=rotate@0.2Hz
- surgical 手术灯: #ffffff i=0.7 r=8u ttl=static
- disco 迪斯科: #ff5cb4 i=0.5 r=10u ttl=static pulse=sine@1Hz
- blood_splash 血溅: #d8201a i=0.3 r=2u ttl=0.5s

# 实体 Entities
## 玩家 Player
- 玩家 player pos=(0,0) vel=(0,0) facing=0.0° hp=1 weapon=fist(拳头) ammo=0 mode=melee reloading=0s mask=null kills=0 hitsTaken=0
